# Overview

Runs the English extraction from CHILDES tokens through negation coding to `english_data/processed_data/english_tokens_processed.feather`. Uses `english` as the working directory with `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, and reuses corpus caches unless `english_force_download` is `TRUE`.

# Setup

Loads `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, configures knitr, and creates `english_raw_dir` and `english_processed_dir`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)

library(childesr)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r directories}
english_db_version <- "2026.1"
english_force_download <- FALSE

english_data_root <- "english_data"

english_raw_dir <- file.path(english_data_root, "raw_data")
english_processed_dir <- file.path(english_data_root, "processed_data")

dir.create(english_raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(english_processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load Data

Selects CHILDES source corpora and imports tokens into `english_all_tokens` for annotation.

## Select Corpora

Selects the Eng-NA and Eng-UK collections in `english_collections` for CHILDES release `english_db_version`.

```{r collections}
english_collections <- c("Eng-NA", "Eng-UK")
```

## Import Data

Downloads or reuses corpus-level English tokens in `english_all_tokens` and checks required columns before combining cached batches.

```{r import_tokens}
english_query_roles <- NULL

english_batch_dir <- file.path(
  english_raw_dir,
  paste0("corpus_batches_", english_db_version)
)

english_corpora_path <- file.path(english_batch_dir, "corpus_list.csv")
dir.create(english_batch_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Corpus list for the collections: fetched once, then reused from disk.
if (!english_force_download && file.exists(english_corpora_path)) {
  english_corpora <- readr::read_csv(english_corpora_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  english_corpora <- childesr::get_transcripts(
    collection = english_collections,
    db_version = english_db_version
  ) %>%
    distinct(collection_name, corpus_name, corpus_id) %>%
    arrange(collection_name, corpus_name)
  readr::write_csv(english_corpora, english_corpora_path)
}

english_batch_files <- file.path(
  english_batch_dir,
  paste0(english_corpora$collection_name, "_", english_corpora$corpus_id, ".feather")
)

# Columns every corpus file must have.
english_required_columns <- c(
  "target_child_id", "target_child_age", "transcript_id", "utterance_id",
  "token_order", "gloss", "part_of_speech", "speaker_role",
  "speaker_code", "utterance_type"
)

# A saved batch is usable if the file exists and has the required columns.
english_batch_is_valid <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(FALSE)
  saved_columns <- names(arrow::open_dataset(path, format = "ipc"))
  all(english_required_columns %in% saved_columns)
}

# Write to a temporary file first, then rename it.
# If R stops mid-write, no half-written batch is left behind.
english_save_batch <- function(data, path) {
  temp_path <- paste0(path, ".tmp")
  arrow::write_feather(data, temp_path)
  if (!file.rename(temp_path, path)) stop("Could not save: ", path)
}

english_failed <- character()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(english_corpora))) {
  path <- english_batch_files[[i]]
  corpus_label <- paste(
    english_corpora$collection_name[[i]], english_corpora$corpus_name[[i]],
    sep = " / "
  )
  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s", i, nrow(english_corpora), corpus_label))

  # Already saved: reuse it.
  if (!english_force_download && english_batch_is_valid(path)) next

  # tryCatch turns an error into a message so the loop moves on.
  tokens <- tryCatch(
    childesr::get_tokens(
      collection = english_corpora$collection_name[[i]],
      corpus = english_corpora$corpus_name[[i]],
      role = english_query_roles,
      token = "%",
      replace = TRUE,
      db_version = english_db_version
    ),
    error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)
  )

  if (is.character(tokens)) {
    english_failed <- c(english_failed, corpus_label)
    message("  FAILED: ", tokens)
  } else if (is.null(tokens) || nrow(tokens) == 0L) {
    message("  No tokens returned.")
  } else if (!all(english_required_columns %in% names(tokens))) {
    english_failed <- c(english_failed, corpus_label)
    message(
      "  FAILED: missing columns ",
      paste(setdiff(english_required_columns, names(tokens)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  } else {
    english_save_batch(tokens, path)
    message("  Saved ", nrow(tokens), " tokens.")
  }
}

if (length(english_failed) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "These corpora failed: ", paste(english_failed, collapse = "; "),
    ". Completed batches remain saved. ",
    "Keep english_force_download <- FALSE and rerun this chunk."
  )
}

# Corpora that returned no tokens have no file, so only saved files are used.
english_valid_files <- english_batch_files[file.exists(english_batch_files)]

stopifnot(length(english_valid_files) > 0L)

# Read each file's column definitions without loading its token rows.
# Standardize integer columns to int64 to avoid int32/int64 conflicts.
english_schemas <- lapply(english_valid_files, function(path) {
  current_schema <- arrow::open_dataset(
    path,
    format = "ipc"
  )$schema

  fields <- lapply(current_schema$fields, function(f) {
    if (f$type$ToString() %in% c("int8", "int16", "int32", "int64")) {
      arrow::field(f$name, arrow::int64())
    } else {
      f
    }
  })

  arrow::schema(fields)
})

# Combine the standardized column definitions.
english_common_schema <- arrow::unify_schemas(
  schemas = english_schemas
)

# Read the cached files using those consistent types.
english_all_tokens <- arrow::open_dataset(
  english_valid_files,
  format = "ipc",
  schema = english_common_schema,
  unify_schemas = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::collect()
```

# Token Processing

Filters `english_tokens` by `target_child_age` and assigns speaker, age, and utterance-type fields before negation coding.

## Filter Ages and Count Exclusions

Filters `english_all_tokens` to finite `target_child_age` values from 0 to under 72 months and records row and child counts in `english_exclusions`. Lowercases `gloss` while preserving its source spelling in `gloss_original`.

```{r exclusions}
english_n_tokens_before_exclusions <- nrow(english_all_tokens)
english_n_chi_before_exclusions <- english_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

english_tokens <- english_all_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    gloss_original = as.character(gloss),
    gloss = str_to_lower(as.character(gloss), locale = "en")
  )

rm(english_all_tokens)
invisible(gc())


english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  filter(is.finite(target_child_age))
english_n_tokens_after_finite_age <- nrow(english_tokens)
english_n_chi_after_finite_age <- english_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  filter(target_child_age >= 0, target_child_age < 72)
english_n_tokens_after_age_range <- nrow(english_tokens)
english_n_chi_after_age_range <- english_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

english_exclusions <- tibble(
  n_tokens_before_exclusions = english_n_tokens_before_exclusions,
  n_after_finite_age = english_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  n_after_age_range = english_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  missing_or_nonfinite_age =
    english_n_tokens_before_exclusions - english_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  outside_age_range =
    english_n_tokens_after_finite_age - english_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  n_chi_total = english_n_chi_before_exclusions,
  n_chi_after_finite_age = english_n_chi_after_finite_age,
  n_chi_after_age_range = english_n_chi_after_age_range
)

english_exclusions
```

## Save Exclusion Records

Saves `english_exclusions` and the age-filtered `english_tokens` as CSV files in `english_raw_dir`.

```{r save_exclusions}
readr::write_csv(
  english_exclusions,
  file.path(english_raw_dir, "exclusions_english_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  english_tokens,
  file.path(english_raw_dir, "english_tokens_excluded.csv")
)
```

## Assign Speaker Roles

Maps target-child roles to `child` and every other role, including missing values, to `parent` in `english_tokens$speaker`.

```{r speaker_roles}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") == "target_child" ~ "child",
      TRUE ~ "parent"
    )
  )
```

## Calculate Age in Months

Calculates `english_tokens$age` as the floor of `target_child_age` in months.

```{r age}
english_tokens$age <- floor(english_tokens$target_child_age)
```

## Recode Utterance Types

Recodes question, imperative, and disrupted labels from `utterance_type` into `english_tokens$utterance_type`, leaving unlisted values unchanged.

```{r utterance_types}
english_tokens$utterance_type <- recode(
  as.character(english_tokens$utterance_type),
  question = "interrogative",
  `broken for coding` = "other",
  `imperative_emphatic` = "imperative",
  interruption = "other",
  `interruption question` = "interrogative",
  `missing CA terminator` = "other",
  `no break TCU continuation` = "other",
  `question exclamation` = "interrogative",
  `quotation next line` = "other",
  `quotation precedes` = "other",
  `self interruption` = "other",
  `self interruption question` = "interrogative",
  `trail off` = "other",
  `trail off question` = "interrogative"
)
```

# Define Target Words

Labels candidate English negators in `english_tokens$word` and assigns their word and syntactic categories.

## Assign Target Word Labels

Normalizes apostrophe variants and assigns `no`, `nope`, `nah`, `not`, and `n't` to `english_tokens$word` when matched.

```{r function_words}
english_tokens$word <- "nonfunction"
english_no_forms <- c("no", "nope", "nah")
english_function_words <- c(english_no_forms, "not", "n't")
english_normalize_negation_form <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_replace_all(
    stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x), locale = "en"), "[‘’ʼ＇]", "'"
  )
}
english_negation_match <- english_normalize_negation_form(english_tokens$gloss)

for (x in english_function_words) {
  english_tokens$word[!is.na(english_negation_match) & english_negation_match == x] <- x
}
```

## Assign Word Categories

Assigns `Negation` to matched targets and `nonfunction` to other rows in `english_tokens$word_category`.

```{r wordcategories}
english_tokens$word_category <- "nonfunction"
english_tokens$word_category[english_tokens$word %in% english_function_words] <- "Negation"
```

## Assign Syntactic Categories

Assigns `Function` to negation targets and `nonfunction` to other rows in `english_tokens$syncategory`.

```{r syncategory}
english_tokens$syncategory <- "Function"
english_tokens$syncategory[english_tokens$word_category == "nonfunction"] <- "nonfunction"
```

# Classify Negation

Normalizes `no` and `not` categories, assigns their scope, and excludes fixed expressions in `english_tokens`.

## Normalize Negation Categories

Pools `no`, `nope`, and `nah` as `no` and pools `not` and `n't` as `not` in `english_tokens$negation_category`.

```{r negation_clean}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    negation_category = case_when(
      english_negation_match %in% english_no_forms ~ "no",
      english_negation_match %in% c("not", "n't") ~ "not",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
rm(english_negation_match)
```

## Assign Negation Scope

Assigns `discourse` to the `no` category and `sentential` to the `not` category in `english_tokens$negation_scope`.

```{r negation_categorization}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  mutate(
    negation_scope = case_when(
      is.na(negation_category) ~ NA_character_,
      negation_category == "no" ~ "discourse",
      negation_category == "not" ~ "sentential",
      TRUE ~ "uncertain"
    )
  )
```

## Reclassify Determiner no

Reclassifies `no` with determiner or quantifier `part_of_speech` tags as `sentential` and records `no_is_determiner`.

```{r determiner_no}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    no_is_determiner = word == "no" &
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(str_trim(
          coalesce(as.character(part_of_speech), "")
        )),
        "^(det|qn)(:|$)"
      ),
    negation_scope = if_else(no_is_determiner, "sentential", negation_scope)
  )
```

## Exclude Fixed Expressions

Excludes `no` in `oh no`, `no problem`, `no worries`, and `no more` by clearing its negation labels and recording `negation_exclusion`.

```{r exclude_fixed_expressions}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  mutate(
    # Neighbouring words, only when they are in the same utterance
    .same_prev = coalesce(lag(utterance_id) == utterance_id, FALSE),
    .same_next = coalesce(lead(utterance_id) == utterance_id, FALSE),
    .prev1 = if_else(.same_prev, lag(gloss), ""),
    .next1 = if_else(.same_next, lead(gloss), ""),
    negation_exclusion = case_when(
      word == "no" & .prev1 == "oh" ~ "oh no",
      word == "no" & .next1 == "problem" ~ "no problem",
      word == "no" & .next1 == "worries" ~ "no worries",
      word == "no" & .next1 == "more" ~ "no more",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    excluded = !is.na(negation_exclusion),
    word = if_else(excluded, "nonfunction", word),
    word_category = if_else(excluded, "nonfunction", word_category),
    syncategory = if_else(excluded, "nonfunction", syncategory),
    negation_category = if_else(excluded, NA_character_, negation_category),
    negation_scope = if_else(excluded, NA_character_, negation_scope)
  ) %>%
  select(-excluded, -starts_with("."))

count(english_tokens, negation_exclusion, speaker)
```

# Expand Negative Forms

Expands words ending in `n't` and `cannot` into auxiliary and negative components in `english_tokens_negation_expanded`. Retains source identifiers and labels only the negative components as `Negation`.

```{r expand_negative_forms}
# Stems that are not simply the word minus n't
english_irregular_stems <- c(wo = "will", ca = "can", sha = "shall", ai = "be")

english_expand_negative_forms <- function(tokens) {
  match_form <- english_normalize_negation_form(tokens$gloss)

  # Any word ending in n't: the stem is everything before n't
  auxiliary_stem <- stringr::str_match(match_form, "^(.+)n't$")[, 2]
  irregular <- !is.na(auxiliary_stem) & auxiliary_stem %in% names(english_irregular_stems)
  auxiliary_stem[irregular] <- english_irregular_stems[auxiliary_stem[irregular]]
  auxiliary_stem[!is.na(match_form) & match_form == "cannot"] <- "can"
  split_token <- !is.na(auxiliary_stem)
  negative_form <- ifelse(match_form %in% "cannot", "not", "n't")

  source_row <- rep.int(seq_len(nrow(tokens)), 1L + as.integer(split_token))
  subtoken_order <- sequence(1L + as.integer(split_token)) - 1L
  expanded <- tokens[source_row, , drop = FALSE]
  expanded$negation_subtoken_order <- subtoken_order

  stem_row <- subtoken_order == 0L & split_token[source_row]
  negative_row <- subtoken_order == 1L
  expanded$gloss[stem_row] <- auxiliary_stem[source_row[stem_row]]
  expanded$gloss[negative_row] <- negative_form[source_row[negative_row]]

  # The auxiliary contributes to the denominator but not the negation numerator.
  expanded$word[stem_row] <- "nonfunction"
  expanded$word_category[stem_row] <- "nonfunction"
  expanded$syncategory[stem_row] <- "nonfunction"
  expanded$negation_category[stem_row] <- NA_character_
  expanded$negation_scope[stem_row] <- NA_character_

  # The negative component is the sole new negation occurrence.
  expanded$word[negative_row] <- expanded$gloss[negative_row]
  expanded$word_category[negative_row] <- "Negation"
  expanded$syncategory[negative_row] <- "Function"
  expanded$negation_category[negative_row] <- "not"
  expanded$negation_scope[negative_row] <- "sentential"

  # Keep standalone apostrophe variants of n't as one token with the n't form label.
  standalone_negative <- subtoken_order == 0L & !split_token[source_row] &
    !is.na(match_form[source_row]) & match_form[source_row] == "n't"
  expanded$word[standalone_negative] <- "n't"
  expanded$word_category[standalone_negative] <- "Negation"
  expanded$syncategory[standalone_negative] <- "Function"
  expanded$negation_category[standalone_negative] <- "not"
  expanded$negation_scope[standalone_negative] <- "sentential"

  if (nrow(expanded) != nrow(tokens) + sum(split_token) ||
      any(!nzchar(expanded$gloss[stem_row])) ||
      any(!nzchar(expanded$gloss[negative_row])) ||
      any(expanded$word_category[stem_row] == "Negation") ||
      any(expanded$word_category[negative_row] != "Negation")) {
    stop("Negative-form expansion failed its row or component checks.")
  }
  expanded
}

english_tokens_negation_expanded <- english_expand_negative_forms(english_tokens)
```

# Save Processed Data

Saves `english_tokens_negation_expanded` to `english_data/processed_data/english_tokens_processed.feather` for downstream counts and plots.

```{r save_processed_data}
write_feather(
  english_tokens_negation_expanded,
  file.path(english_processed_dir, "english_tokens_processed.feather")
)
```
